description.value:
Trigger A living creature moves into the trapped area

Effect The glyph scuttles in front of the triggering creature and rearranges itself to spell out a terrifying threat, such as "You are about to die." The creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:40|options:inflicts:fleeing,inflicts:frightened] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fleeing] for 1 round. A fleeing creature moves toward the nearest trapped area, or in a random direction if no trapped areas remain.

details.description: Magical glyphs crawl across the floor, ceiling, and walls of the hallway.
details.disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:38] or @Check[athletics|dc:38] (expert) to move through the area before the glyph activates, @Check[arcana|dc:40] (expert) to unweave the glyph's animating magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Dispel Magic] (9th rank; counteract DC 36)
